program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # input pair L
    "gmidp": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS load / 2nd stage gm/Id (matched)
    "Lp":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # PMOS load / 2nd stage L (matched)
    "gmidb": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # NMOS bias mirrors gm/Id
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias mirrors L
    "Itail": (40e-6, 15e-6, 50e-6),  # stage-1 tail current
    "I2":    (25e-6, 8e-6, 30e-6),   # stage-2 current
    "winv":  (1.2, 0.5, 4.0),        # inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 3x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]

    # PMOS mirror load (diode side + output side); balance level o1 = vdd - vgs3
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=1.0)
    vo1 = vdd - m3.vgs
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=vdd - vo1)

    # input pair with body effect: iterate the common-source node
    vs = 0.2
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=max(vo1 - vs, 0.1), vsb=vs)
        vs = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.05)

    # NMOS bias: diode on ibias, tail and stage-2 sink mirrored (same L, gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], It, vds=vs)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # stage-2 PMOS CS: same gm/Id and L as the load, so its gate sits at vo1 -> no systematic offset
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # inverter
    wn = p["winv"]; wp = 3.0 * wn; linv = 0.15

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.M("MIP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp, linv)
    n.M("MIN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn, linv)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gds1 = m1.gds + m4.gds
    A1 = m1.gm / gds1
    gds2 = m6.gds + m7.gds
    A2 = m6.gm / gds2
    cinv = (wn + wp) * linv * 8.5e-15 + (wn + wp) * 0.6e-15
    C1 = m6.cgg + m6.cgd * A2 + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = m6.cdd + m7.cdd + cinv
    tau1 = C1 / gds1
    tau2 = C2 / gds2
    idrv = min(wn * 450e-6, wp * 150e-6)
    tinv = (cl + 2e-15) * vdd / 2 / idrv
    tpd = 0.7 * (tau1 + tau2) + tinv

    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    # residual systematic offset: o2 balance vs inverter threshold
    offset = 0.3 / max(A1 * A2, 1.0)
    pol = 1 if offset < spec.get("vod", 0.01) else 0

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": pol,
               "A1": A1, "A2": A2, "vs_tail": vs}
